# sdwan_sig_security_sig_feature (Data Source)

This data source can read the SIG Security SIG Feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sdwan_sig_security_sig_feature" "example" {
  id                 = "f6b2c44c-693c-4763-b010-895aa3d236bd"
  feature_profile_id = "f6dd22c8-0b4f-496c-9a0b-6813d1f8b8ac"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Required

- `feature_profile_id` (String) Feature Profile ID

### Optional

- `id` (String) The id of the Feature
- `name` (String) The name of the Feature

- `aup_timeout` (Number) Custom Acceptable User Policy frequency in days
